title: Alur Maklon Inti (PO -> Confirm -> Surat Jalan -> Invoice)
description: Alur bisnis kritikal Portal Maklon (jasa CMT): buat PO Maklon dari klien, Confirm PO (otomatis membuat Work Order per item + Draft AR Invoice), kirim hasil produksi via Surat Jalan/Dispatch (partial/penuh), lalu posting AR Invoice ke Finance GL. Pembayaran & finalisasi status invoiced ada di modul Billing (ringkas).
happy_path_steps: Buat PO Maklon: pilih klien + tambah item (seri, artikel, qty, rate CMT) -> POST /pos -> status draft.
Confirm PO: POST /pos/{id}/confirm -> status confirmed + auto Work Order per item + auto Draft AR Invoice.
Surat Jalan/Dispatch: POST /dispatches (pilih item & qty) lalu PUT /dispatches/{id}/confirm -> PO partial_delivered/completed.
Posting AR: POST /finance/pos/{id}/post-ar -> AR Invoice ter-posting ke GL (status issued).
(Opsi) Pembayaran & finalisasi invoiced di modul Billing.
